master-1.title: Senior Master Electrician & Smart Home Specialist
master-1.bio: Licensed master electrician with over 12 years of hands-on experience in residential rewiring, smart breaker panel upgrades, EV charger installations, and emergency troubleshooting. Guaranteed safety and zero compliance issues.

rev-1.comment: Alex is an absolute wizard! Upgraded our old 100A panel to a 200A smart panel and installed our Tesla Gen 3 charger seamlessly. Kept everything spotless and explained every detail.
rev-1.craftsmanReply: Thanks David! It was a pleasure working on your home electrical setup.

rev-2.comment: Super punctual, professional, and friendly. Installed 12 recessed lights in our living room with zero drywall damage. Highly recommended!

master-2.title: Master Plumber & Hydro-Jetting Expert
master-2.bio: Specialist in trenchless pipe repair, tankless water heater installations, luxury bathroom plumbing fixtures, and high-pressure sewer drain jetting.

rev-3.comment: Arrived within 30 minutes of my emergency call at midnight! Fixed the leaking main line quickly and saved our basement floors.

master-3.title: Award-Winning Interior Architect & Designer
master-3.bio: Transforming luxury apartments and urban villas with Scandinavian minimalism and Japandi elegance. 3D photorealistic renderings, custom lighting plans, and full furniture curation.

rev-4.comment: Sarah elevated our penthouse into a work of art. The attention to natural light, wood textures, and ambient glow is unmatched.

master-4.title: HVAC Specialist & Climate Automation Specialist
master-4.bio: EPA 608 Universal certified technician specializing in multi-zone VRF systems, Nest/Ecobee smart thermostat integration, and ductwork air quality purification.

master-5.title: Master Decorative Painter & Wall Artist
master-5.bio: Specializing in Venetian plaster finishes, limewash aesthetics, crisp modern accent walls, and zero-VOC eco-friendly paints for healthy home environments.

master-6.title: Smart Home Security & CCTV Systems Engineer
master-6.bio: Designing unbreachable perimeter security for estates and residences. 4K PoE camera arrays, night-vision AI detection, encrypted NVR storage & remote mobile control setup.
